items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: Julia Rinker, who was the daughter of Al Rinker, who was one of the Rhythm Boys with Bing Crosby for Paul Whiteman.

ctx.x: Well now I mean I’m still playing jazz clubs. I just, in April I went to my bottom file cabinet, got out my Mildred Bailey music and remembered that I had done a very special event in her home state of Washington, Spokane and Tekoa, which is a tribal, a tribal lands where she grew up. And I asked Loren Schoenberg — are you familiar with him? I knew you would be, very important in our jazz world. He’s so busy teaching and conducting bands, he’s, and he was Bobby Short’s music director at one time. But I © Fillius…

talked him into doing that with me and not only playing alto — excuse me, tenor sax — which he doesn’t get to do as often, but he’s a marvelous pianist. So he did both. He played piano for me. I also played as well. That took some doing, just figuring out how to get on and off the piano bench, but we did it. And I had James Chirillo on guitar and Boots Malison on bass and it was so wonderful to give those songs a dust-off and get to talk about her a little bit.
